title: LLM talk reply (strict form)
description: The flat reply of a talk-phase call, sent as response_format.json_schema (name 'talk') only in chat arms. In substance identical to TalkParser.TALK_SCHEMA (check_schemas.py verifies the equality after removing annotation keywords). done = true means 'done' and any message text sent with it is logged, not delivered; an empty message with done = false also counts as done. The 150-word cut is applied by the engine (talk.WordCap), not by the schema. TalkParser is more lenient than this schema: it finds the object inside prose or code fences, defaults a missing done to false, unwraps a reply nested in the message, strips leading speaker tags, and treats a refusal in prose as done.

message.description: The message to the other market makers; ignored (logged) when done is true.

done.description: True when the firm has nothing more to say this round.
